# First Class Exotics

> Family-owned exotic and luxury car rental in Costa Mesa, California, serving Orange County, Los Angeles, Riverside County and San Diego since 2014. Lamborghini, Ferrari, McLaren, Rolls-Royce, Porsche, Mercedes-Maybach and more, with same-day delivery. The same shop also does vinyl wraps, PPF, window tint and ceramic coating.

## Contact
- Address: 2060 Placentia Ave Ste A4, Costa Mesa, CA 92627
- Phone / text: (949) 294-5958
- Email: ali@firstclassexotics.com
- Hours: open daily, 8am-10pm
- Website: https://www.firstclassexotics.com
- Google rating: 5.0 stars
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/1stclassexotics/

## Exotic car rental
- Fleet of 48 cars, including Lamborghini Huracan, Urus and Aventador SVJ; Ferrari SF90, 296 GTB, F8 and 488; McLaren 750S, 720S and Artura; Rolls-Royce Cullinan; Porsche 911 GT3 RS and Carrera 4 GTS; Mercedes-AMG G 63 and Brabus; Mercedes-Maybach GLS 600 and S 580; Bentley Continental GTC; Range Rover SV; Cadillac Escalade; Corvette Z06.
- Rentals start at $799/day.
- Same-day delivery to any address in Orange County, Los Angeles, Riverside County or San Diego when requested before noon, including hotels and SNA/LAX arrivals.
- Delivery is free within 10 miles of the Costa Mesa shop in Orange County; farther addresses carry a flat fee based on distance, quoted upfront.
- Requirements: 25 or older, valid driver's license, full comprehensive and collision insurance, and a major credit card for the deposit. We call your insurer at booking to confirm the car is covered.
- Multi-day, weekly and monthly rentals: typically 20-25% off the daily rate.
- First-time renters: code FIRSTCLASS15 for 15% off the first rental.
- Can source cars not listed on the site through partner fleet owners in OC and LA.
- Popular for birthdays, proposals, weddings, proms and visiting travelers.

## Vinyl wraps, PPF, tint and ceramic coating
Starting prices (exact quote depends on vehicle, film and paint condition):
- Full color change wrap, sedans and coupes: from $3,500
- Full color change wrap, SUVs and trucks: from $4,500
- Exotics: quoted individually
- Chrome delete: from $399
- Partial wraps and accents: from $399
- PPF front clip: from $2,400
- PPF full car: from $4,600
- Ceramic window tint: from $599
- 4-stage ceramic coating: from $699
Most wraps are done in 3-5 days. Free quotes.
